name: Salute_1
short_caption: The robot brings its right hand to its temple in a polite salute gesture.
movement_description: Starting from a neutral posture, the robot slightly tilts its head forward and raises its right arm. It brings its right hand toward its temple, performing a brief and polite salute. After holding the salute briefly, the robot lowers its right arm and returns its head to the upright, neutral position.
safety_notes: The robot's right arm sweeps upward and outward; ensure there are no obstacles immediately to its right side.
